title: Full Stack Web Developer
description: An intensive, project-based training program covering the entire web development lifecycle. Focused on building front-end interfaces with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Next.js, alongside back-end development, database management, and deployment processes.
achievements: Developed and deployed multiple full-stack applications, culminating in a comprehensive capstone project using Next.js.
Engineered RESTful APIs to manage data flow between the client-side and server-side of applications.
Practiced Agile (Scrum) methodologies and Git version control in a team-based environment to simulate a professional workflow.

title: Front End Web Developer Intern
description: Contributed to the development and maintenance of the front-end codebase for client-facing projects. Collaborated closely with UI/UX designers and product managers to translate Figma designs into functional, responsive Svelte.js components.
achievements: Successfully translated Figma designs into pixel-perfect, responsive UI components using Svelte.js and CSS.
Assisted in debugging and refactoring existing code, helping to improve application stability and UI consistency.
Participated in code reviews and agile ceremonies, gaining hands-on experience in a professional development workflow.

title: Cloud Engineer
description: An intensive program focused on cloud computing principles and technologies using Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Covered topics in cloud architecture, containerization with Docker, and automation scripting with Python.
achievements: Successfully deployed Python applications on Google Cloud Platform services like App Engine and Cloud Run.
Utilized Docker to containerize applications, ensuring consistent and reproducible environments for development and deployment.
Completed a capstone project involving the design and implementation of a scalable, cloud-native solution on GCP.
